messages:
ryan: Heads-up: onboarding demo uncovered PII in logs coming from the ruby sample CLI. When auth retries fail we see emails and token fragments in the printed error. Repro with RW_LOG_LEVEL=debug on ruby-sdk v0.6.1.

uma: can you paste the exact line (redact locally if needed)?

ryan: redacted snippet from local run: [ERROR] auth.retry id=req42 token=eyJhbGciOi... user_email=pat.sanders@example.com status=401

bennett: thanks. Sounds like the ruby SDK's logger adapter isn't running the sanitizer on exception backtraces. We sanitize HTTP bodies but not exception.message/inspect.

uma: also noticed Otel spans in the CLI don't get the request id attribute. We set x-rw-request-id for HTTP but the CLI command runner isn't wiring tracer attributes.

ryan: proposal: (1) add a global logger middleware in ruby sdk that sanitizes any outgoing log string/object (errors, exceptions, backtraces), (2) ensure our CLI runner extracts/generates a request id and sets span attribute `rw.request_id`, (3) add a simple config flag `telemetry.redact_patterns` and `telemetry.request_id_header` in sample app.

bennett: sample config idea for README: { "telemetry": { "redact": true, "redact_patterns": ["email","jwt","ssn"], "request_id_header": "x-rw-request-id", "log_level_env": "RW_LOG_LEVEL" } }

uma: tests: unit for sanitizer on Exception#message and nested hashes, integration that runs the CLI with RW_LOG_LEVEL=info and triggers auth retry ensuring logs contain `[REDACTED]` for email/jwt and Otel span has `rw.request_id`.

security-bot: flagged issue RW-PII-701: "ruby-cli: log redaction + request_id propagation" assigned to bennett/uma, label: PII, security-review required

bennett: i'll open a small PR to: move sanitizer into logger adapter, patch retry logic to sanitize errors before raising, and add span attribute wiring in CLI runner. will include tests. ETA: patch this week.

ryan: thanks. can one of you review quickly when it's ready? we want sample CLI fixed before the next onboarding session.

uma: can review after standup. also recommend adding RW_SAFE_DEMO=true to example scripts to force INFO and auto-redact in demo runs.

ci-bot: created ticket SDK-telemetry-732 for CI smoke that asserts no email/jwt regex in logs for demo runs
